content.title: Complete a single-product purchase
content.description: A customer purchases the Aurora Wireless Headphones through a single-product checkout by selecting a quantity between 1 and 9, optionally applying a supported promo code or an unknown code that yields no discount, reviewing a live order summary that shows subtotal, discount, tax, and total, and completing the purchase to receive a confirmation showing the exact amount charged.
content.summary: Buy Aurora headphones with quantity, promo, live totals, and confirmation.
content.value: Enables revenue-generating checkout with transparent pricing and an exact purchase confirmation.
criteria: Unit price is $40 for the Aurora Wireless Headphones.
Quantity can be set from 1 to 9.
Subtotal equals unit price multiplied by quantity.
Promo codes SAVE10 and SAVE25 reduce the subtotal by 10% and 25%; an unknown code applies no discount.
The discount appears on its own line in the summary.
Tax is 10% of the discounted subtotal, and total equals discounted subtotal plus tax.
For 2 units with SAVE25, the total is $66.00 after subtracting $20 and adding $6 tax.
Completing the purchase shows a confirmation with the exact total charged.
